title: Building – Construction Compliance with ABC 2006 and Professional Involvement Compliance July 2012
description: An owner's long-stalled residential construction project used manufactured engineered products (trusses, sheathing) left exposed to the weather. A consulting engineer's report found the structure not sound and not built to plan, and recommended 12 corrective items or removal and rebuilding of the superstructure.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an s.49 order

outcome_summary: Order substance kept (complete the engineer's items 1–12 or rebuild), but the deadline was extended to 14 Sept 2012.
